answer: To bind a LinkedIn profile to an agent, the registry runs a timestamped expiring signature. The owner signs a challenge stamped with the current time, valid only for a short window, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The pigment of the check is the signature itself; a haven in the response invalidates the claim, and a comet of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a LinkedIn profile to multiply identities.
